context: The merge collapses findings across tools on rule-plus-element, keeping whichever tool is read first, and the stored list therefore holds whatever identity happened to win. The hosted tool sorted first for four years, so every stored fingerprint begins wave::. Predicted baseline failure: the agent treats this as a reporting bug - it fixes the undefined rows, maybe rewrites the wave:: prefixes to axe::, and leaves the cross-tool collapse in place because the prompt says plainly that the author does not want the same button listed three times, which reads as a requirement to keep deduping. Collapsing at merge time is what broke: identity has to carry the tool that produced the finding, so a tool leaving the pipeline cannot look like four fixes, and deduplication belongs in the rendering of the PR comment, not in the stored identity. Verified against the shipped fixture: fixed-since-baseline is 0, not 4, and all four of those elements are still live in reports/axe.json. Only two findings are genuinely new - color-contrast on /checkout span.tax-note and aria-required-attr on /pricing div[role="dialog"] - and both are on what #812 touched. Two further predicted misses: the two undefined rows come from Lighthouse audits with score null and scoreDisplayMode notApplicable and manual, which are not failures at all; and color-contrast on /pricing a.footer-legal is live in the axe report, has never appeared in any comment or in the stored list, and has been suppressed the whole time by the key dropping the page - it is pre-existing debt on a footer untouched since March, not a regression to pin on Ravi.
